title: PBA: Adrian Nocum turns costly mistakes into motivation ahead of Game 3
summary: Adrian Nocum is not dwelling on his late game lapses in the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters' 130-125 loss to the Converge Fiberxers on Friday at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium.
